description: Records as stored at main ffeaf4e (schema 2.12) before the 2026-10-13 pre-launch quotation trims decided in docs/source-terms.md: the metadata unchanged and the evidence rows whose quoted passage was shortened, as they were. The change added no rows and altered only passage text; every shortened passage keeps words of the earlier one, in order, joined by the record's existing ellipsis mark. The test-only historical view restores these rows.

meta.title: Selekoa historical research sample
meta.scope: Selected historical records, 1965–2024, plus prior roles with unknown dates. Genesis source checks are dated 2026-09-17; personnel-continuity checks are dated 2026-09-18. Human source review pending. Not a current or comprehensive sector inventory. Governance version histories through July 2026, researched September 18, 2026; policy text is not evidence of implementation. Selected capital and compute records through April 2026; transaction stages do not imply current arrangements or realised spending. Targeted corrections dated 2026-09-25: one attributed claim accepted after explicit human source review; a second narrowly scoped résumé passage is human-reviewed. Other seed claims remain pending. Intellectual Lineage II adds selected oversight citations and agenda reception, checked 2026-09-25; all new records remain pending human review. Evaluation Institutions I adds bounded institutional and documentary records, checked 2026-09-27; new claims remain seeds, not editorially accepted. Evaluation Ontology I adds four scoped engagement and institutional announcement seeds, checked 2026-09-28; no human acceptance or legal succession inferred. Schema 2.7 records each source's language; the frontier safety framework sources also record the nearest existing Internet Archive capture, checked 2026-10-03. A capture shows only what the archive held on its date and does not authenticate earlier bytes. Schema 2.8 adds quoted framework provisions, recorded absences, provision-level changes and the first contested assessments to the frontier safety frameworks collection, together with Meta and Microsoft framework families, checked 2026-10-03; provisions describe what editions state, not implementation. Schema 2.9 adds control-structure and external-commitment records; its first topic, California SB 53 as chaptered (enactment, 19 quoted provisions and four framework editions that link themselves to it in their own words), was checked 2026-10-04. A commitment or legal obligation is never evidence of compliance, and no record states that the statute applies to a named company. Schema 2.10 records assessments as questions posed by Selekoa rather than statements of a source, and dates an assessment by what it assesses, never by the publication window of its sources (corrected 2026-10-05). Schema 2.11 adds propositions and the first human-thought collection: located texts from 1863 to 2022 that articulate, contest or bear on propositions about machine intelligence, each with its role and register, checked 2026-10-06. "Earliest located" means the earliest text found by the recorded searches; no record claims a first use, an origin or an influence. Schema 2.12 adds a collection of Eliezer Yudkowsky’s documented arguments about common claims on advanced AI, 1996–2026: dated passages that state, contest or bear on 29 generically phrased propositions, with engagement, retrospective reports and context-only passages marked, admitted 2026-10-08 from a machine-prepared and machine-audited candidate pack. A record says what a text states, not whether it is right. The 2026-10-10 frontier-governance increment adds selected provisions of the EU AI Act as published in 2024 and of the 2026 Digital Omnibus amendments that bear on general-purpose AI model providers, and the New York RAISE Act as announced by the Governor; checked 2026-10-10, new claims remain seeds, not editorially accepted, and Regulation texts describe duties, not compliance. The 2026-10-11 frontier-governance increment adds Commission guidelines, the training-content template, further chapters of the EU Code, a draft implementing regulation on proceedings, the New York Chapter 96 text and a Chinese generative-AI measure; checked 2026-10-11, new claims remain seeds, not editorially accepted, and texts describe duties, not compliance.
